title: After the Typhoon
intro: Hi, sorry, it’s been a long couple of days. I’m Nina. The typhoon came through Tuesday night and the river came right up into our house.
My mom and my two kids are still sleeping at the school.
The village is getting recovery money and there’s a meeting Saturday about how to spend it and whether people rebuild where they were.
I want to have an opinion before I walk in. Can you help me think it through?
